content:
maria: FYI attached alloc snapshot from the prod-shard-12 OOM (see /mnt/ci/artifacts/alloc-2951234567.snap). I suspect a steady stream of 32–64B allocations from tokenizer buffers — fragmentation + slow eviction.

 dave: looked at the flamegraph — a lot of ~48B churn from LRUTouch::record_touch() and TokenBuffer::append(). :eyes:

 jin: can you paste the snapshot summary? rough RSS vs. anon mappings?

 maria: Snapshot summary (top lines):
```
RSS: 68.3G  anon: 54.1G  mapped: 10.2G  heap-alloc-samples: 2.1M
Top alloc sites:
 - TokenBuffer::append (48B x 1.2M)
 - ParserState::push (96B x 400k)
 - std::string resize (24B x 600k)
```

 olivia: rerouting load helped but didn't stop growth. we also saw increased slab fragmentation on nodes with > 60% occupancy.

 maria: proposed immediate mitigations:
 - lower shard cache soft_limit from 80% -> 65% of node RAM (maria) — roll tomorrow morning
 - add alloc sampling in production (dave) to catch allocation stacks for small objects
 - enable jemalloc background purge and tune lg_dirty_mult on the large-memory fleet (jin)
 - add eviction trace logs for LRU misses (olivia)

 dave: I'll wire up the sampling hook and a lightweight collector (p99 CPU <1%) — aim EOD Thu.

 jin: quick patch idea: replace per-request small std::string allocations with a thread-local slab for token buffers. I'll open PR with bench results by Mon.

 maria: created follow-up tickets:
 - RW-5021 reduce-shard-soft-limit (owner: maria, due: 3d)
 - RW-5022 alloc-sampling-prod (owner: dave, due: 2d)
 - RW-5023 jemalloc-tuning (owner: jin, due: 5d)
 - RW-5024 lru-eviction-logs (owner: olivia, due: 2d)

 olivia: also adding a recurring check to the weekly incident retro to watch for repeated small-allocation patterns (tag: memory-pattern).

 sre-bot: alert: prod-shard-12 OOM at 2951234510 — auto-restart performed. See incident RW-5019.

 maria: next steps: we'll track these four tickets in the memory playbook board and do a mid-week sync. If anyone wants to take ownership of the slab patch (jin) ping me.

 dave: noted. I'll attach sampling dashboards and a synthetic repro harness to RW-5022.

 jin: will run microbench vs quantized and full model and report fragmentation delta.

 olivia: thanks all — please add short PR links to the tickets when ready. :thumbsup:
